item.title: Dems demand DHS fund election security. And, journalist Gloria Steinem has died
item.description: Two Democrats are demanding that Homeland Security officials fund election security ahead of the midterms. And, trail-blazing journalist Gloria Steinem has died.

item.description: Eight days after Nepal's flash floods, families who can't find loved ones perform symbolic cremations.

item.title: China's Xi visits Egypt for the first time in a decade
item.description: Xi Jinping's visit to Egypt for the first time in a decade, and during the Iran war, comes as U.S. allies broaden their security ties.

item.title: Critics question legality of Venezuela oil deals
item.description: Chevron's $7 billion Venezuela bet deepens U.S. ties to the country's oil industry. Critics say the deal poses risks to democracy and could fuel discontent over Washington's embrace of the government.

item.title: U.S.-Israel relations are on the rocks ahead of elections
item.description: Relations between the Trump administration and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have turned rocky since Trump called a truce with Iran. Trump seeks progress in Gaza, but Netanyahu is taking a defiant stance ahead of an election.

item.title: Xi visits Egypt as China seeks deeper influence across the Mideast
item.description: China's President Xi Jinping visits Egypt this week for the first time in a decade. The trip illustrates China's growing ambitions at a time when U.S. influence has been weakened by its war in Iran.

item.title: Ex-Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and wife seek to end drug charges case on immunity grounds
item.description: Former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife have asked a judge to dismiss the drug trafficking indictment against them on the grounds that they have immunity as the leader and first lady of a foreign country

item.title: A jury in Malta acquits a businessman in the killing of reporter Daphne Caruana Galizia
item.description: Investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia had written extensively about suspected corruption in political and business circles in Malta. She was killed by a car bomb in 2017, at age 53.

item.title: Iran fires on its Gulf neighbors, retaliating for U.S. strikes after a monthlong lull
item.description: The six-month war has led to a spike in oil prices, roiled the global economy and posed increasing political problems for President Trump's Republican Party ahead of November midterm elections.

item.title: Greetings from the Royal Pavilion, a stunning reminder of India in southern England
item.description: Looking up at this 18th century building, it became clear the British didn't only bring their architectural style to India. They also took some of India's style home.
